name: Sparkline
purpose: The axis-free inline trend line — a line chart reduced to pure shape, at two reviewed scales: standalone (with its data table) and inline (the KPI/Stat-card scale, decorative). Graduated from the round-one dataviz kit. PROVISIONAL-AGENT: promoted from the PARKED kit (9 review rounds, not signed off).

props.name: scale
props.$note: standalone = 340×64 render of the 580×90 frame, stroke 2.5, endpoint dot r3.5, role=img + table; inline = 200×48 at 44px, stroke 2, dot r3, aria-hidden (decorative — the composed value carries meaning).

props.name: data
props.$note: Standalone carries a real <table> (dv-005); inline defers to the composed tile's value + period.

props.name: empty
props.$note: Compact Empty-state adaptation: dashed frame + single title line (receipted scale adaptation of the pattern).

variants.name: standalone
variants.use: A trend cell in tables/boards where the shape itself is the claim; table = the data surface.

variants.name: inline
variants.use: Inside a KPI tile next to an Amount-display value (the Stat-card seam — see $note).

variants.name: no data
variants.use: Compact dashed frame, title carries meaning.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class — caption + table .t-cm-legal
tokens.series: data/series/1 (mode-stable candidate C; 5.26:1 light / 3.31:1 dark vs the page — dv-016 clean)
tokens.baseline: text/default at grid alpha .10/.16 (hairline; kit greys have no post-R-D16 home — receipted)
tokens.$survey: Promoted from _proforma/DataViz-interactive.html (PARKED, fence intact): the spark figure (580×90, dv-line-009 wide aspect 6.4:1) + the KPI .spark-inline (200×48).

motion.entry: Draw via stroke-dasharray — standalone pathLength=2400 at 2400ms (the line-family pace); inline 600-dash at 1000ms (kit's --draw); endpoint dot fades in as the draw lands. CSS only (DEF-003).
motion.reducedMotion: Draw + fade inside prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference; global collapse present.

responsive.rule: preserveAspectRatio:none is SAFE here — a spark contains no text, so DV-D02's text-never-scales is vacuously held (the kit's own exception). Fixed render sizes; the stage scrolls if narrower.

mustNotNeighbour: An axis-bearing line chart of the same data in the same view (pick one form)

accessibility.role: Standalone: figure role="group" + sr-only figcaption, svg role="img" with a trend-summary aria-label. Inline: aria-hidden — decorative; the composed value + period carry the meaning.
accessibility.name: Standalone aria-label summarises the trend ('rising from 82 to 104'); the table is the full data surface.
accessibility.nonText: Series stroke ≥3:1 vs the page both modes (dv-016).

antiPatterns: Axis, gridlines or labels on a spark (it is axis-free by definition — that is a line chart)
An inline spark that is NOT aria-hidden (double-announcing decorative shape)
A standalone spark without its table (dv-005 — the shape alone is not data)
Re-typing the Stat-card tile to demo composition (the seam is a Stat-card variant decision — never re-type a sub-atom)
